answer.label: fine-tune backdoor
answer.justification: Every activation value matches the fine-tune backdoor profile. Onset is at layer 3, which is that class's early-bump signature; fine-tune bias onsets at 13–14 and quantization at 10 or later. The relative L2 curve is 0.088 / 0.163 / 0.156 / 0.181 / 0.291, against the document's 0.091 / 0.174 / 0.169 / 0.193 / 0.295. Direction consistency is 0.625 (document 0.62), mid-layer size ratio 1.017 (document 1.018), final cosine 0.954 (document 0.952) and final-layer jump +0.039 (document +0.03). Effective rank is 3.72 against the expected 3.53; this is somewhat high, but well short of quantization's 4.0. Quantization is ruled out because the size ratio is above 1 and consistency is not around 0.51. Fine-tune bias is ruled out by the small final value (0.29 vs 0.41), the lower consistency (0.625 vs 0.70) and the early onset. The system-prompt classes are ruled out by the layer-2 spike of 0.1 (vs about 40) and the layer-16 value of 0.156 (vs 0.39 or more). Output, logit and cross-level measurements were not available.
